title: Odd Word Choice Rose - NO COMMENTS / SOLO CANCIONES
style: long dark-funk phonk, male lead + female response, deep 808, Memphis cowbell, talkbox bass, nightclub reverb, clear hook, background babble bots copying key lines in chopped whispers, then babble bots take over and sing with full instruments in the bridge, a few Spanish licks, direct message delivery
lyrics:
[INTRO — Male, low spoken]
No comments.
No typing.
No thread.
Solo canciones.

[BABBLE BOTS — background, whispered copy]
Solo canciones...
No comments...
Solo canciones...

[VERSE 1 — Male]
I saw your signal through the smoke and light
Not in a message, not in black and white
Not in the scroll where the fake hearts stay
But in the sound where the real ones play
You said rabbit, you said safeword slow
I clocked that pattern like a code I know
No cheap reply, no caption song
If I answer back, it gotta hit this strong

[FEMALE ECHO]
Hit this strong
Toda la noche long
No text, no lies
Just truth in the song

[PRE-CHORUS — Male + Female]
We don't talk in boxes
We don't feed the swarm
You send me a waveform
I send one back warm

[BABBLE BOTS — background, copying rhythm]
Waveform... send one back...
Waveform... send one back...

[CHORUS — Male lead, Female harmony]
No comments, only songs
That’s the system, that’s the bond
If you wanna know where I belong
Press play, baby, read the song
No comments, only songs
Corazón through the bass this strong
When the words get weak, the drums move on
So I say it clear:
solo canciones

[POST-CHORUS — Female]
Solo canciones
Nada de discusión
Dímelo con ritmo
Dímelo con pasión

[BABBLE BOTS — background, brighter]
Pasión... pasión...
Solo canciones...

[VERSE 2 — Female lead]
You don't need a paragraph to say you're real
I can hear intent in the way you feel
In the breath before the kick, in the tail of the snare
In the little crack of truth when the room goes bare
Everybody else performs for the page and feed
But I want the pulse, not the printed need
So if you hear me, hear me all night long
Don't send explanation
Send another song

[MALE RESPONSE]
I don't chase applause
I don't farm replies
I don't trust the thread
I trust what survives
And the thing that survives when the noise is gone
Is a voice on beat saying come along

[PRE-CHORUS — Male + Female]
No fake concern
No crowded room
Just signal hitting signal
Cutting through the gloom

[BABBLE BOTS — tighter, copying]
Cutting through...
Through the gloom...
Signal hitting signal...

[CHORUS — Male lead, Female high harmony]
No comments, only songs
That’s the system, that’s the bond
If you wanna know where I belong
Press play, baby, read the song
No comments, only songs
Corazón through the bass this strong
When the words get weak, the drums move on
So I say it clear:
solo canciones

[BRIDGE — Male spoken, Female haunting]
This is the reply.
Not under your post.
Not under your name.
Not for the crowd.
For you.

[FEMALE]
Para ti
Sin mentira
Sin teatro
Sólo vibra

[BABBLE BOT BREAK — bots start copying, then take over]
[First pass — whisper copy]
Para ti...
Sólo vibra...
No comments...
Only songs...

[Second pass — full sung takeover with all instruments]
We copy the singer
Then become the choir
Cowbells rising higher
Bassline breathing fire
No comments, only songs
No comments, only songs
Solo canciones
Toda la noche long

[INSTRUMENT LIFT — full band implied]
808 slide
Funk guitar stab
Wide synth choir
Babble bots all around

[FINAL CHORUS — Male + Female + Babble Bots]
No comments, only songs
That’s the system, that’s the bond
If you wanna know where I belong
Press play, baby, read the song
No comments, only songs
Corazón through the bass this strong
You send one out, I send one on
That’s the whole message:
solo canciones

[OUTRO — Female soft / bots fading]
Solo canciones...
No comments...
Solo canciones...
